text:
maria: heads up, backup-bot spiked errors for restores of archived DB snapshots. error: \"decrypt failed: missing key metadata\". looks like CMK id header missing on objects.
backup-bot: ALERT 1735810005 - 6 restores failed in last 30m. uploader v2.1.0
aj: is this uploader config or KMS propagation?
samir: root cause: canary deploy replaced multipart uploader with a fork that strips any customer headers prefixed with 'x-encrypt-' when composing parts. our CMK was in x-encrypt-cmk.
maria: which tenants affected? customer-facing or internal?
leo: scan shows ~420 objects from 2026-03-19 to 2026-03-21 missing x-encrypt-cmk. mostly multipart uploads (>5GB).
aj: paste the check command used.
leo: `gsutil stat gs://redwood-backups-prod/tenant-12345/db-snap-20260320.tar.gz` -> x-encrypt-cmk: MISSING. S3 head-object same.
nancy: do audit logs show KMS decrypt attempts?
samir: none. restore aborts early when metadata missing, so no KMS calls recorded.
maria: mitigation options: revert uploader fork or fallback to tenant-default CMK when header missing. risks?
aj: auto-fallback risky - might violate customer key scoping. need security sign-off.
nancy: no auto-fallback. enable a manual restore path where ops can provide CMK after tenant verification. require audit entry.
leo: plan: revert to upstream uploader v2.0.7 which preserves metadata. canary in ~1h, prod in next deploy window after smoke. I'll open PR.
samir: repair options for affected objects: reupload from originals (safe) or metadata-replace via compose (GCS supports metadata replace but has edge cases). reupload safer but costs bandwidth.
leo: ~420 objects, avg 12GB (~5TB). can reupload bucket-to-bucket over 24-48h with throttling. will produce manifest CSV of affected objects.
maria: create migration ticket and customer impact matrix. Samir/Nancy, draft customer comms with verification checklist. include proof-of-possession steps.
nancy: require ops to post ephemeral grant id and audit log entry for every manual restore.
eng-oncall-bot: note created: #INC-2026-249 assigned to leo. severity P2.
leo: PR: https://github.com/redwood/backup-agent/pull/1287 (revert fork). kicking tests.
maria: timeline: revert canary (leo) 1h, smoke tests 3h, prod rollout 6h, migration ticket 2h, ops comms 2h.
aj: forensics: snapshot current objects list before repair to preserve state evidence.
leo: manifest pushed to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/INC-2026-249/manifest.csv
maria: after prod revert, pilot reupload for 2 tenants to verify KMS audit entries. no auto-repair until pilot succeeds.
samir: long-term add CI test for multipart compose preserving metadata and a deploy gate for uploader lib changes.
leo: adding tests to PR.
nancy: update runbook \"restore when CMK header missing\" with legal/key-ownership checks.
maria: good. any objections?
aj: none :thumbsup:
eng-oncall-bot: canary deployed 1735804868 to canary cluster-3. basic smoke passed.
leo: found one GCS compose edge-case returning 412 on metadata replace; will fall back to reupload for that object.
samir: sharing customer comm drafts in #encryptops-comms and cc legal.
maria: we'll convert to postmortem if more than 1 tenant impacted or compliance alerts surface. closing loop later today. :lock:
